description: This file contains an implementation of an image importer for BMP images within the PDFsharp library. It includes classes for reading BMP image data, testing BMP headers, and converting image data into formats suitable for PDF embedding.

classes.name: ImageImporterBmp
classes.description: Implements BMP image importing logic, including header testing and image data extraction for BMP files.

classes.name: ImportedImageBitmap
classes.description: Represents an imported BMP image ready for PDF processing.

classes.name: ImageDataBitmap
classes.description: Holds bitmap image data in a format suitable for PDF embedding.

classes.name: ImagePrivateDataBitmap
classes.description: Contains private data for BMP images, including raw pixel data and methods for copying and converting bitmap data.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Attempts to import a BMP image from the provided stream.

methods.name: TestBitmapFileHeader
methods.description: Checks if the provided stream starts with a valid BMP file header.

methods.name: TestBitmapInfoHeader
methods.description: Validates the bitmap info header and supported formats in the BMP data.

methods.name: PrepareImage
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to prepare image data for PDF, not implemented.

methods.name: CopyBitmap
methods.description: Copies bitmap pixel data into a format suitable for PDF embedding, supporting various pixel formats.
